dialogue.content: did the laundry and answered nothing for three hours.
someone gave me a lift without me asking. nice of them.
someone rescheduled and I was more relieved than I should admit.
stood outside a place for ten minutes before going in.
made a list of people to check on. didn't check on them.
when someone's done me an actual favour I stop performing fine around them. the debt makes me honest — I can't do the everything's-great routine with someone who's seen me need something.
it just doesn't come out. the routine stops working.
got the train instead of driving and read most of the way.
turned off read receipts and told nobody.
swapped a call for a message and everyone was fine with it.
bought a card and didn't write in it yet.
sat in the same seat as last time out of habit.
sorted out a difficult thing on my own. fine.
someone summarised a two-hundred-message thread for me.
every friendship of mine that got properly close did it straight after I'd asked for something. the ones where I've only ever been the capable one have stayed exactly where they were for years.
said I'd host something and immediately regretted the scale.
left a party early and nobody minded.
put a recurring reminder on something I'll ignore.
checked the weather for a plan that isn't confirmed.
